text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both gaining modestly in a day of light upside, with Ethereum outpacing Bitcoin at +2.9% versus +2.0%, signaling some rotation into altcoins. The Fear & Greed index remains deeply depressed at 22 despite a week-long recovery, and Bitcoin dominance holding steady above 55% suggests investors are still risk-averse even as prices inch higher. Trading volume at $64B is subdued relative to crypto volatility, indicating this bounce lacks conviction and the market is watching for a clearer directional signal.
